name: Psychic Buffer (Duergar)
body:
–

Benefit: Years of living near creatures that attack your mind has sharpened your defenses; you are skilled at repelling mental assaults, and gain a +1 trait bonus to Will saves against Telepathy powers.

Special: Only Duergar may select this Racial Trait
